title: Queue-inversion tableau formula for all modified Macdonald polynomials with formal q and t
difficulty: The proof constructs new queue-inversion signed involutions and degenerate-filling bijections, proves symmetry through LLT ribbon expansions, and establishes both Macdonald triangularity conditions by exhaustive weighted-word transformations. Full telescoping identities and all special word cases are supplied, so the final uniqueness argument does not assume the claimed tableau formula.
scope: The selected problem is exact original Theorem2.6, the queue-inversion tableau formula for every modified Macdonald polynomial with formal q,t and every partition, including repeated/degenerate column lengths. Complete author Sections1--10 through the final proof2530--2533 retain precise filling/queue-triple/statistic/weight definitions, Macdonald axioms and superization, LLT symmetry proof, both triangularity proofs, every Phi-degenerate-tableau and weighted-word bijection, all local cases/telescoping identities and the complete terminal uniqueness argument. The introductory proof sketch is retained only as author orientation; the actual full new proofs are included separately in source order. Later open questions about weight-preserving queue/HHL bijections are unselected. All original author tableau macros, letter/number cell diagrams, TikZ drawings, cancellation markings, general formulas and human proof remain fully editable TeX, with no diagram/proof images or substitute package. The existing scaffold qbinom definition is undefined immediately before loading the exact original author qbinom definition; this resolves a standalone macro-name collision without changing any author body/math definition. Rendering-only source note: exactly seven orphan semicolons after graphical d/h/v state definitions647/648,1005/1006/1007,1149/1151 are omitted in the standalone wrapper, as approved by root. All path-terminating semicolons, coordinate values, labels, proof/general formulas and original raw source remain unchanged; no global PGF alias or warning suppression. Six original author percent newline guards in the graphical header (native89/97/100/112/120/121) are restored verbatim after the earlier header extraction removed them. Original cell definitions, paths, coordinates, labels, fonts and alignment controls are unchanged. This restores authored newline suppression rather than substituting a diagram renderer.
